patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,2 +1,69 @@
-def recite(start_verse: int, end_verse: int) -> list[str]:
-    pass
+def recite(start_verse: int, end_verse: int) -> list[str]:
+    animals = [
+        "fly",
+        "spider",
+        "bird",
+        "cat",
+        "dog",
+        "goat",
+        "cow",
+        "horse"
+    ]
+    
+    reactions = [
+        "",
+        "It wriggled and jiggled and tickled inside her.",
+        "How absurd to swallow a bird!",
+        "Imagine that, to swallow a cat!",
+        "What a hog, to swallow a dog!",
+        "Just opened her throat and swallowed a goat!",
+        "I don't know how she swallowed a cow!",
+        "She's dead, of course!"
+    ]
+    
+    descriptions = [
+        "",
+        " that wriggled and jiggled and tickled inside her",
+        "",
+        "",
+        "",
+        "",
+        "",
+        ""
+    ]
+    
+    verses = []
+    
+    for i in range(start_verse, end_verse + 1):
+        verse_lines = []
+        
+        # First line - what she swallowed
+        verse_lines.append(f"I know an old lady who swallowed a {animals[i-1]}.")
+        
+        # Special case for horse (last verse)
+        if i == 8:
+            verse_lines.append("She's dead, of course!")
+        else:
+            # Reaction line (except for fly)
+            if i > 1:
+                verse_lines.append(reactions[i-1])
+            
+            # Cumulative part - what she swallowed to catch what
+            for j in range(i-1, 0, -1):
+                if j == 1:
+                    # For fly, no extra description
+                    verse_lines.append(f"She swallowed the {animals[j]} to catch the {animals[j-1]}.")
+                else:
+                    # For others, include the description
+                    verse_lines.append(f"She swallowed the {animals[j]} to catch the {animals[j-1]}{descriptions[j-1]}.")
+            
+            # Final line
+            verse_lines.append("I don't know why she swallowed the fly. Perhaps she'll die.")
+        
+        verses.extend(verse_lines)
+        
+        # Add empty line between verses (except after the last verse)
+        if i < end_verse:
+            verses.append("")
+    
+    return verses
